paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира промяната в перплексията на валидационния набор WikiText за три модели — LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B и Vicuna-7B — след прилагане на метода OWL за прунинг при фиксирана разреженост от 70% и различни стойности на параметъра M, който варира от 3 до 8. По хоризонталната ос (M) са показани целочислени стойности с равни интервали, без единици, като всяка точка отговаря на конкретна стойност на M. По вертикалната ос (Perplexity) е представен диапазон от около 15 до 45, с етикети на интервали от 10, без указани единици, като стойностите са линейно масштабирани. Линията за LLaMA1-7B (зелена, с кръгли маркери и плътна линия) започва при перплексия около 32 при M=3, спада леко до около 28 при M=5, след което се покачва до около 35 при M=8. Линията за LLaMA1-13B (оранжева, с триъгълни маркери и плътна линия) започва при перплексия около 20 при M=3, спада до минимум около 17 при M=5 и M=6, след което леко се покачва до около 20 при M=8. Линията за Vicuna-7B (синя, с триъгълни маркери и плътна линия) започва при перплексия около 41 при M=3, спада до около 34 при M=5, остава почти постоянна до M=7, след което се покачва до около 40 при M=8. Всички три линии показват някаква степен на вариация в перплексията в зависимост от M, без да има еднозначна монотонна тенденция.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart displays the WikiText validation perplexity for three language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—each pruned to 70% sparsity using OWL, with perplexity plotted against varying values of M (a pruning parameter). The x-axis, labeled “M,” spans integer values from 3 to 8, with linear spacing and no units. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” ranges from approximately 15 to 45, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The green line with circular markers represents LLaMA1-7B, starting at a perplexity of 28.5 at M=3, dipping to 24.5 at M=5, then rising to 36.5 at M=8. The orange line with star markers corresponds to LLaMA1-13B, beginning at 20.0 at M=3, decreasing to 16.5 at M=5, and rising slightly to 20.5 at M=8. The blue line with triangular markers indicates Vicuna-7B, starting at 41.0 at M=3, declining to 34.5 at M=6, then increasing to 40.0 at M=8.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after being pruned to 70% sparsity using the OWL method, with perplexity measured across different values of the pruning parameter M ranging from 3 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “M,” is linearly scaled from 3 to 8 with integer tick marks at each unit. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” is linearly scaled from approximately 15 to 45, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. Three distinct lines represent the models: LLaMA1-7B (green circles connected by solid lines) starts at a perplexity of ~28 at M=3, dips slightly to ~25 at M=5, then rises to ~36 at M=8; LLaMA1-13B (orange stars connected by solid lines) begins at ~20 at M=3, declines to ~17 at M=5, and gradually increases to ~20 at M=8; Vicuna-7B (blue triangles connected by solid lines) starts at ~41 at M=3, decreases to ~34 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then rises to ~40 at M=8. All lines show non-monotonic behavior, with local minima around M=5 or M=6, and generally increasing perplexity toward higher M values.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the WikiText validation perplexity of three language models — LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B — as they are pruned to 70% sparsity using the OWL method across varying values of M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick marks at intervals of 10.0. The blue line with triangle markers, representing Vicuna-7B, begins at approximately 41.0 perplexity at M=3, decreases to around 35.0 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then rises to about 40.0 at M=8. The green line with circle markers, corresponding to LLaMA1-7B, starts at roughly 29.0 at M=3, dips slightly to 26.0 at M=5, then gradually increases to approximately 36.0 at M=8. The orange line with star markers, for LLaMA1-13B, begins at about 20.0 at M=3, declines to a low of approximately 16.5 at M=6, and then rises to around 20.5 at M=8. All three lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior across the range of M values.
